what: The whole demo price file (no secrets in it: pay_to is an env placeholder)
stdout:
# Local demo config: the gateway in front of demo/origin, settling through the SIMULATED
# facilitator (demo/mock-facilitator). No chain, no money; every payment is labelled
# simulated. For real devnet payments use agenttoll.example.yaml.
origin: http://127.0.0.1:4000
listen: 127.0.0.1:8402
admin_listen: 127.0.0.1:8403
public_url: http://127.0.0.1:8402
detection: agents-only

networks:
  solana:
    network: "solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1"   # devnet (KB-SOL-01)
    asset: "4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU" # devnet USDC (KB-SOL-01)
    pay_to: "${AGENTTOLL_SOLANA_PAYTO}"
    facilitator: "http://127.0.0.1:4020"                  # SIMULATED

routes:
  - match: "GET /api/quote"
    price_usd: "0.002"
    description: "Live price quote"
  - match: "GET /api/*"
    price_usd: "0.001"
  - match: "GET /blog/*"
    price_usd: "0.001"
  - match: "/*"
    price_usd: "0"

mcp:
  endpoint: /mcp
  advertise_prices: true
  tools:
    search_docs: "0.005"
    generate_report: "0.05"

ledger:
  url: "sqlite://.demo/agenttoll-demo.db"
